description: Nexora Heatmap is an Arabic-first matrix heatmap for Power BI, built with full right-to-left (RTL) support. It crosses two dimensions — such as regions by months — and turns the values into color, so peaks, gaps and patterns show up instantly where a plain table would hide them. Key features: - Sequential color scale between a low and a high color, with an optional legend and end labels. - Values inside the cells, with an optional suffix. - Number formatting: number, percent and currency — including the official Saudi Riyal symbol (U+20C1). - Independent colors for row and column headers, full font control. - Adjustable cell gap, borders and corner radius for a polished grid. - Selection and cross-filtering: click a cell to filter the rest of the page. - Arabic/English support with true RTL rendering. Everything runs inside your report: no external services, no network calls, no telemetry your data never leaves Power BI. Ideal for: density analysis across two categories, comparing months by regions, spotting peaks and gaps, and reading performance patterns in a grid. A full 30-day trial is included. After the trial, all features remain available a small watermark appears until a license is obtained via AppSource.
